# Test data

Every file here must come from a permissively licensed source or be generated by a reference tool acting
as an oracle. Record the source, its license and its version or commit next to each file (in this README).

**Never add GPL-licensed vectors**, such as dpkg's `t-version.c`, rpm's `tests/rpmvercmp.at`, apk-tools'
`test/unit/version.data`, or univers' `alpine_test.txt` and `rpmvercmp.at`. See
[docs/RESEARCH.md](../docs/RESEARCH.md#licensing-of-test-data).

| Directory | Source | License | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `vers-spec/` | [package-url/vers-spec `tests/`](https://github.com/package-url/vers-spec/tree/main/tests) | MIT | *not yet vendored* |
| `osv-scalibr/` | [google/osv-scalibr `semantic/testdata`](https://github.com/google/osv-scalibr/tree/main/semantic/testdata) | Apache-2.0 | *not yet vendored* |
| `oracle/` | Generated by `scripts/oracle/` from the real tools in containers | MIT (our output) | *not yet generated* |
